# `fs`

Files and folders: whole-file reads and writes, listing, metadata, and `File` handles that read or write piece by piece.

```colibri
import fs
```

Needs the `fs` capability.

Back to the [standard library index](README.md).

### `Error`

```text
enum Error {
    NotFound
    PermissionDenied
    AlreadyExists
    NotADirectory

    DirectoryNotEmpty

    Closed

    Other
}
```
